'''Anarra''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who sought to spread the ideals of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. She was one of four Wookiees within her family.

==Biography==
[[File:EndorFamily.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Anarra's family's home on Endor]]

During the Life Day festivities of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Anarra resided on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] with her family. Her family included [[Oraalarri]], [[Radrrl]] and [[Tebeurra]].<ref name="AED" />

Oraalarri would have [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] speak to Anarra and other members of her family to learn more about Life Day. Though naturally sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], due to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] enslavement of her [[Species/Legends|species]], she, like the rest of her family, welcomed Imperials to their home. They told these Imperials that while they themselves may not be bad people, corruption and darkness would consume them as they grow more powerful within the Empire.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Anarra was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. During the Life Day event of [[2004]], players could talk to Anarra on either Endor or Yavin 4 to learn about Life Day.
